header.title: How to Calibrate an Oven
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to calibrate your oven, regardless of whether it uses analog or touchpad controls. Learn to accurately measure and adjust your oven's temperature for consistent baking results.

steps.description: This step involves comparing the actual oven temperature with its setting to determine the temperature variance and whether recalibration is needed.
actions: Check the temperature sensor at the top of the back wall of the oven.
Ensure the temperature sensor is properly secured and not touching other parts.
Place a grate at the halfway height of the oven chamber.
Place or hang the oven thermometer in the center of the oven chamber.
Close the oven door.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C).
Allow the oven to heat for at least 20 minutes.
Take a temperature reading.
Take readings every 20 minutes for about two hours or at least four readings.
Calculate the average temperature from all readings.

steps.description: This step details how to calibrate an oven with analog controls by adjusting the thermostat knob.
actions: Remove the oven temperature knob from its post by pulling it out.
Pry the knob out gently using a butter knife or a flat blade screwdriver if there is resistance.
Turn the knob over and look at the back for a notched disk and a pointer.
Make a mark on the disk to remain in perspective with the original setting.
Loosen the screws holding the disk in place.
Rotate the disk slightly within the limit of its slotted adjustment, guiding yourself with the 10° marks.
Tighten the screws back up to secure the disk in place.
Return the knob onto its post.

steps.description: This step details how to adjust the oven temperature using the touchpad, emphasizing the importance of consulting the owner's manual for specific instructions.
actions: Consult the owner's manual for oven calibration instructions.
Locate the section about oven calibration or adjusting oven temperature in the manual.
Identify the button(s) to press and the duration to activate the calibration process.
For Kenmore C970, press the “Bake” button and set the temperature to 550°F (287°C), then press “Bake” again within two seconds.
Look for a double-digit display to confirm entering calibration mode.
Identify the displayed offset number (e.g., “00”, “SF”, “F TempOffset”).
Enter the temperature difference using the numeric touchpad or arrow buttons.
If using a numeric touchpad, press the “Flex Clean” button to add a plus or minus sign.
Confirm the selection by pressing the “Bake” button (or follow manual instructions for other models).
Test the calibration using steps 1.1 to 1.6.
